mapper.select: select c.title as title, m.plays as plays, m.completion_rate as completionRate from heron_news_metric m join heron_video_version v on v.version_id = m.version_id join heron_news_work w on w.work_id = v.work_id join heron_news_candidate c on c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id where m.fetched_at = ( select max(m2.fetched_at) from heron_news_metric m2 where m2.version_id = m.version_id) order by m.fetched_at desc limit #{limit}

select v.version_id as versionId, m.plays as plays, m.completion_rate as completionRate, m.likes as likes, m.comments as comments, m.shares as shares, m.fetched_at as fetchedAt, v.publish_at as publishAt, v.duration_ms as durationMs, v.input_snapshot as inputSnapshot, v.script as script, v.content_profile as contentProfile, c.source_kind as sourceKind, c.candidate_id as candidateId from heron_news_metric m join heron_video_version v on v.version_id = m.version_id
left join heron_news_work w on w.work_id = v.work_id left join heron_news_candidate c on c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id where m.fetched_at = ( select max(m2.fetched_at) from heron_news_metric m2 where m2.version_id = m.version_id) and m.plays is not null order by m.fetched_at desc
